Microsoft WebView2 SDK 1.0.3912.50 (WebView2.h, WebView2EnvironmentOptions.h, x64/WebView2Loader.dll)
Source: MSYS2 package mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-webview2-loader 1.0.3912.50-1, BSD-3-Clause (LICENSE.txt)
Used by PS-WRAP for the in-app PlayStation Network sign-in window (gui/src/pswrappsnweblogin.cpp).
WebView2Loader.dll imports KERNEL32 only, so it works with the mingw64 build.
